data.one_liner: Animate the initialization of any widget with custom directions and dismissible options.
data.what_it_does: Provides an AnimatedCard widget that wraps any child widget to animate its entry upon initialization. It supports configuration of direction, duration, delay, and a custom dismiss action.
use_when: You want to add entrance animations to list items or cards.
You need a simple wrapper widget that handles both entry animations and optional dismissal.
avoid_when: You need complex physics-based motion or advanced Rive/Lottie animations.
You are looking for state management or dependency injection tools.
strengths: Easy to implement with a single wrapper widget.
Supports customizable entry direction, duration, and delay.
weaknesses: Limited to initialization animations and basic dismissal.
Older package with minimal recent updates beyond null safety.
